limitations: Only a fresh owned detached worktree is created. The original checkout, source, capture and real Git packs remain unchanged.
The exact local commit and available objects are used; lazy fetch, network prompts, automatic maintenance and hooks are disabled.
Synchronous SMB/system calls can delay polling; no hard end-to-end timeout is claimed. Failure preserves the partial checkout for review.

ownedProcesses.scope: Only identities observed as this spawned Node child or its descendants. PPID, PGID and any user-data-dir are retained as provenance; every signal rechecks start time, UID and exact argv. No process-group/name-wide signals.
